s.note: Barry running late for work again
s.how: Fry 4 rashers of bacon until crisp and fry 4 eggs until just set. Split and toast 4 English muffins and butter them. Fill each with bacon, an egg and a slice of cheddar, then wrap tightly in paper so the cheese melts on the way.

Pop 100g popping corn in a big lidded pot. Melt 60g butter with the zest of a lime and a pinch of chilli flakes. Pour over the popcorn while tossing hard so every piece is coated, then squeeze over a little lime juice and serve straight away.

m.note: the can of tomatoes Barry's mum forgot
m.how: Soften a diced onion and crushed garlic in olive oil. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer gently for 45 minutes. Stir in torn basil and season. Toss through 500g cooked spaghetti and finish with grated parmesan, just like the family kitchen.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter, whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes and cool. Cut into squares and pipe a yellow lightning bolt of icing sugar mixed with a drop of colouring on each.

d.n: Central City blood orange lightning fizz
d.how: Simmer 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp water and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Mix 1 tbsp caster sugar with a pinch of salt on a saucer, wet the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip them in. Fill with crushed ice. Mix 400ml blood orange juice with the juice of 2 limes and the ginger syrup, pour into the glasses and top each with 80ml sparkling water.
